notes.title: JUDGMENT DAY.
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="w9WPVj2iuw8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]“Three billion human lives ended on August 29th, 1997. The survivors of the nuclear fire called the war Judgment Day. They lived only to face a new nightmare: the war against the machines.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]28 years ago, humanity’s future was stolen by Skynet. Soon, it will be up to you to take it back.[/p][p][/p][p]The flames of the apocalypse are closing in…face them head-on in [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i], coming October 31st, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]For more information about [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i], visit [url="http://www.terminator2d.com"]http://www.terminator2d.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to follow us on [u][url="https://twitter.com/Reef_Games"]X[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://www.facebook.com/ReefGames"]Facebook[/url][/u] for continued updates on [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i] and future projects![/p]

The trailer gives an in-depth summary of [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i]’s various gameplay systems, so you can be prepped and ready for battle when the game releases on October 31st, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the full video to learn all about [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i]’s several game modes, the game’s arcade-style scoring system and more![/p]

notes.title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE Release Date Moved to October 31, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p][i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i] will now be releasing on October 31, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]Coordinating and manufacturing the physical release has been a longer process than we anticipated, and as a result, we’ve had to delay the release of the game. We apologise, and thank you for bearing with us.[/p][p][/p][p]This delay will also give the team at Bitmap Bureau extra time to apply some final polish to the game itself and we would like all players to have the opportunity to experience the best version of T2D together. As such, this delay will apply to both physical and digital versions of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]From the moment we announced T2D, the response has been absolutely amazing, humbling, and truly much greater than anything we could have ever expected. So, to all of you, thank you so much for your support. We know that this news is disappointing and we appreciate your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]We are dedicated to delivering the best release possible for [i]Terminator 2D: NO FATE[/i], and we look forward to sharing more of the game with you soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Reef Entertainment[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE moves to an October release
notes.notes:
Reef Entertainment announced recently that Terminator 2D: NO FATE has moved the release date from September to October 31st.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/terminator-2d-no-fate-moves-to-an-october-release/

notes.title: Terminator 2D: NO FATE
notes.notes: [p]We are thrilled to announce an update to the Steam Page of Terminator 2D: NO FATE, the upcoming officially licensed 2D action side-scroller published by Reef Entertainment and developed by Bitmap Bureau. You can now head to the Steam Page to see a new video broadcast, including a first-time look at the complete Attract Sequence of the game, lovingly crafted to recapture the pixel-lit glory days of the arcade![/p][p]Additionally, fans can check out a behind-the-scenes look at how the team tackled the challenge of translating one of cinema’s most enduring cultural touchstones into a complete arcade experience, capturing the unforgettable scenes and moments that helped shape a generation.[/p][p]Past and future collide in Terminator 2D: NO FATE, launching on [b]October 31st, 2025[/b]. Don't forget to Wishlist now![/p]
